scope: CHOOGuard coding worker orchestration, not in-game NPC provider configuration

states.allocationResearch: Read-only scout: trace CHOOGuard NpcAgentRuntime and related C# gameplay simulation/UI allocation hot paths after a measured 500-actor Editor GC p95 of 4.19 MB/frame. User prefers openai-codex/gpt-6-luna; model escalation only if task-specific complexity needs it.
states.inputResearch: Read-only scout: trace CHOOGuard DetailedInteractionController, FirstPersonResponder and existing physical manipulation tests. Identify real consumer-visible input/lifecycle defects and a safe actual-input acceptance path preserving the clean open FpsStation scene and another modeling session. No edits, builds, tests or Unity commands. User prefers openai-codex/gpt-6-luna; model escalation only if task-specific complexity needs it.

model.instructions: Recommend a worker model; honor the user-preferred Luna default unless it is materially inadequate for this task.

criteria.luna: Use openai-codex/gpt-6-luna for source investigation the preferred worker can reasonably handle.
criteria.astra: Escalate to openai-codex/gpt-6-astra only when complexity makes Luna materially inadequate.

effort.instructions: Recommend the lowest sufficient supported reasoning effort for accurate, evidence-backed read-only analysis.

criteria.high: Substantial cross-file lifecycle, correctness or performance reasoning.
criteria.xhigh: Unusually difficult intertwined reasoning above high.
criteria.max: Exceptional complexity; maximum effort is necessary, not the default.
